identity.description: Copper CRM: a CRM for relationship-focused service businesses that works inside Google Workspace. Its REST Developer API is documented at developer.copper.com.
identity.identity_notes: copper.com is the CRM (confirmed by homepage). Do NOT conflate with developer.copper.co, which is a different company's platform (api.copper.co/platform, Copper crypto/custody API) and was returned in some searches. Its base URL and rate-limit details were excluded.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization Code Grant (per official OAuth page). Client credentials issued after app registration via partners@copper.com. Refresh-token behavior not documented on the page I fetched.
auth.scopes_notes: Only developer/v1/all is currently supported (described as 'Read and modify user records'). More granular scopes are promised for the future.

access.production_restrictions: OAuth2 requires registering the app first: contact partners@copper.com with app name, purpose, and an HTTPS callback URL to receive client_id and client_secret. No app-review requirement was found.

read_ops: Fetch single record and list/search for Account and Users, Leads, People, Companies, Opportunities, Projects, Tags, Tasks, Activities, Custom Fields, Field Layouts, Related Items
write_ops: Create (including bulk create for several resources)
api.limitations: Official developer docs say the API is still expanding. Rate limits not documented on the official page. Whether API access requires a paid plan is unresolved: third-party docs conflict (n8n says Professional or Business; StackOne says the 14-day trial includes API access). Base URL https://api.copper.com/developer_api/v1 and the X-PW-* header names come from third-party guides, not the official page I fetched. No official SDK found.

claims.value: Copper is a CRM for relationship-focused service businesses, built to work inside Google Workspace (copper.com, product confirmed)
claims.quote: Copper is a CRM software for relationship-focused service businesses, built to work inside Google Workspace.

claims.value: 14-day free trial, no credit card required, on all plans
claims.quote: Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial, and no credit card is required.

claims.value: Three per-seat paid plans: Basic, Professional, Business
claims.quote: Copper has three plans, priced per seat, per month.

claims.value: OAuth authentication is open to all users, not only admins
claims.quote: Authentication is open to all users, not just administrators.

claims.quote: To use OAuth2.0 with Copper, you must first register your application.

open_questions: Does API access require a paid plan? Third-party sources conflict (n8n: Professional or Business; StackOne: trial includes API). Check support.copper.com.
Official base URL and exact auth header names (X-PW-AccessToken, X-PW-UserEmail, X-PW-Application) were not confirmed on the official developer.copper.com page.
OAuth access token lifetime and refresh-token behavior are not documented on the official OAuth page.
API rate limits are not documented on the official developer page.

No official Copper MCP server was found in searches or on copper.com/developer.copper.com. Community MCP servers (Glama, mcpservers.org, Conare) were seen in search results only and not fetched; none was verified as a live repo.
No official SDK repository was found. Only unofficial SDKs were seen in search results.

rationale: Self-serve test credentials (trial self serve) and a documented REST interface.
